what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Rule paths include .github/workflows/**/* even though the scope asks for a point-of-edit reminder when .sh files are edited
scenario_or_breakage: This broadens the new rule to workflow YAML and requirements files, adding non-.sh trigger surface beyond the approved doc-only minimum-change plan
suggested_fix: Remove .github/workflows/**/* from the frontmatter paths. Keep the CI/pre-commit exception in the rule text only.
